  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]

Severity disagreement: gemini, openai and glm said MAJOR; minimax said NIT, calling it a documented, intentional degradation that matches the #9473 fallbacks. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 checked this finding and rejected it as intended behaviour, citing lines 165-171 and 181-182 and the issue's G1 ("the count is the raw one, as today").

  WHY: This path runs only when gh_helpers.sh fails to source; the main helper covers the problem on the common path. Reported as SEVERITY: NIT.

- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:lines 181-190 (the in-script fallback `zombie_queued_live_count`); cf. last-run edit at line 188 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fallback runs only when `source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/gh_helpers.sh"` at line 163 fails, and it emits `<total>\t0` (the raw pre-#10032 count with wedged=0), so 245 queued runs (240 wedged) still trigger runner_queue_deep. It also does not check `${1}` against the repo regex the main helper uses (line 4485), so a malformed repo argument builds `repos//actions/runs?...`.
  WHY: This only happens when gh_helpers.sh cannot be sourced. The behaviour is intentional and documented (lines 181-182) and matches the #9473 fallbacks, so it is a documented degradation rather than a strict defect. The last autofix turn did not address it; it only tightened the regex to `^[0-9]{1,12}$`.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:lines 183-190 (fallback zombie_queued_live_count), sourced at line 163, consumed at lines 771-781 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When gh_helpers.sh cannot be sourced, the fallback ignores the limit (arg 2) and cutoff (arg 3) and returns the raw total with wedged=0 after one per_page=1 read. The caller compares that total with the limit at line 779 and calls skip_release runner_queue_deep at line 781. Nothing in the logs marks the degraded path, and wedged=0 is reported even though wedged runs were not excluded.
  WHY: Whenever gh_helpers.sh fails to load and wedged runs push the raw total over the limit, the release cycle is skipped with AUTO_RELEASE_SKIPPED reason=runner_queue_deep queued=<raw total>. This reproduces the 2026-11-23 stall, and the log line looks the same as a correct live-count decision. Suggested fix: when the limit and cutoff are > 0, do the second `created=<=cutoff` read and subtract, clamped to [0, total].
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
